workarounds.symptom: pydantic-core-2.50.2: test needs pydantic
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Bump Ruff to 0.17.3. Target files: pydantic-core/python/pydantic_core/__init__.py, pydantic-core/python/pydantic_core/core_schema.py, pydantic-core/python/pydantic_core/_pydantic_core/__init__.pyi. Enabling the new rules, and fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14183 along the way. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14186)

workarounds.symptom: Deep-copying a self-referential model changes its object graph
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix deep copy of self-referential models. Target files: pydantic/main.py, pydantic/root_model.py, tests/test_construction.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14093. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14116)

workarounds.symptom: No PyPy 8.0 wheels for pydantic-core
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Publish `pydantic-core` wheels for PyPy 8.0 (`pp80` ABI). Target files: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Closes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13977. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14083)

workarounds.symptom: Defer formatting discarded errors during nested union serialization
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Lazily call repr of values during nested union serialization. Target files: pydantic-core/src/serializers/errors.rs, pydantic-core/src/serializers/type_serializers/union.rs, tests/test_serialize.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14073. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14082)

workarounds.symptom: `typing.Self` in a parametrized generic dataclass now fails schema generation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix `Self` resolution in parametrized generics. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py, tests/test_types_self.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14064, regression in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13614. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14065)

workarounds.symptom: 2.14 regression: datetime fields fail schema generation inside freezegun's freeze_time
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Add notes about `datetime` support for mocking the current time. Target files: docs/api/standard_library_types.md. https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14055#issuecomment-[REDACTED]. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14059)

workarounds.symptom: model_rebuild() fails with NameError: name 'T' is not defined on PEP 695 generic models with forward references`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix forward annotations evaluation and type variables substitution when rebuilding parametrized generic models. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_fields.py, pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py, tests/test_forward_ref.py. Alternative to https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14053, which doesn't introduce regressions. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14021. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/11223. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14054)

workarounds.symptom: Type variables wrongly replaced when two models share the same type variable instance
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix forward annotations evaluation and type variables substitution when rebuilding parametrized generic models. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_fields.py, pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py, tests/test_forward_ref.py. Alternative to https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14053, which doesn't introduce regressions. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14021. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/11223. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14054)

workarounds.symptom: KeyError when unpickling (some) ValidationErrors
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix pickling of `PydanticCustomError` and `ValidationError`s containing custom errors. Target files: pydantic-core/src/errors/validation_exception.rs, pydantic-core/src/errors/value_exception.rs, tests/test_errors.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14034. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14051)

workarounds.symptom: Pydantic v2 removes model.dict() and class Config: orm_mode=True, raising PydanticUserError during model serialization.
workarounds.workaround: Replace model.dict() with model.model_dump() and Config: orm_mode=True with model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).

workarounds.symptom: Parametrized generic models no longer resolvable by `__module__`/`__qualname__` (pickle fails) since 2.14.0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix unpickling of generic classes defined in separate module. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_generics.py, tests/test_forward_ref.py, tests/test_generics.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13991. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13994)

workarounds.symptom: pydantic v2.14.1: Fix `TypeError` on `ForwardRef` on Python 3.10.0 by @Viicos in [#13964](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13964)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix `TypeError` on `ForwardRef` on Python 3.10.0 by @Viicos in [#13964](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13964). Upstream PR #13964. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13964)

workarounds.symptom: models_json_schema reuses a serialization body for a nested validation model
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix JSON Schema cache key mismatch with nested `json_schema_mode_override`. Target files: pydantic/json_schema.py, tests/test_json_schema.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13971. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13980)

workarounds.symptom: Sequence validation reconstructs named tuples incorrectly
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support named tuples in `Sequence` validation. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_validators.py, tests/types/test_sequence.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13976. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13978)

workarounds.symptom: Huge int input to a timedelta field wraps to a small wrong timedelta
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Reject out-of-range int inputs for `timedelta`. Target files: pydantic-core/src/input/datetime.rs, tests/test_datetime.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13969. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13973)

workarounds.symptom: `max_digits` whole-digit limit not enforced when a validator precedes `Field` on `Decimal`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Enforce the `max_digits` whole-digits limit in the Python `Decimal` validator. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_known_annotated_metadata.py, pydantic/_internal/_validators.py, tests/types/test_decimal.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13965. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13972)

workarounds.symptom: TypedDict `closed`/`extra_items` (PEP 728) not inherited by subclasses; `extra_items=Never` and `ReadOnly[...]` fail
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support `closed` and `extra_items` via inheritance in `TypedDict`. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py, tests/test_types_typeddict.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13919. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13967)

workarounds.symptom: `ZoneInfo` validation raises `IsADirectoryError`/`OSError` instead of `ValidationError` for some invalid keys
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Handle OS errors during `ZoneInfo` validation. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_validators.py, tests/test_types_zoneinfo.py, tests/types/test_zoneinfo.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13908. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13912)

workarounds.symptom: IPv4Address accepts integer in JSON in non-strict mode
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Correct documentation about IP address strict mode validation. Target files: docs/api/standard_library_types.md. Closes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13888. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13894)

workarounds.symptom: Attribute-docstring inspection raises TypeError while cloudpickle reconstructs a local model in a fresh worker
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Handle `TypeError` gracefully during docstring extraction. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_docs_extraction.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13870. Catching the error is fine, as `cloudpickle` later restores the docstring (and actually the whole `FieldInfo` instances) directly from the pickled data. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13874)

workarounds.symptom: Field(multiple_of=0) panics with an uncatchable PanicException instead of raising a user error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Require `multiple_of` constraints to be positive. Target files: pydantic-core/src/validators/decimal.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/float.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/int.rs. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13860. Also disallowing negative values (this is a breaking change in theory but there's no reason for users to do this, and they easily use a positive value instead) so that we don't emit invalid `multipleOf` JSON Schema values (that are required to be `> 0`). (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13862)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-1812] Pydantic regular expression denial of service (Affects pydantic < 2.4.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pydantic to patched release >= 2.4.0: pip install --upgrade 'pydantic>=2.4.0' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-1812)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-mr82-8j83-vxmv] Pydantic regular expression denial of service (Affects pydantic < 2.4.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pydantic to patched release >= 2.4.0: pip install --upgrade 'pydantic>=2.4.0' (Advisory: GHSA-mr82-8j83-vxmv)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-5jqp-qgf6-3pvh] Use of "infinity" as an input to datetime and date fields causes infinite loop in pydantic (Affects pydantic < 1.8.2)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pydantic to patched release >= 1.8.2: pip install --upgrade 'pydantic>=1.8.2' (Advisory: GHSA-5jqp-qgf6-3pvh)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2021-47] Pydantic is a data validation and settings management using Python type hinting. In affected versions passing either `'infinity'`, `'inf'` or `float('inf')` ... (Affects pydantic < 1.8.2)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pydantic to patched release >= 1.8.2: pip install --upgrade 'pydantic>=1.8.2' (Advisory: PYSEC-2021-47)
